profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Architect, Certified SysOps
profile.summary:
I am a passionate cloud architect and software engineer with extensive experience working in AWS and Google Cloud platforms, where I use tools such as Kubernetes, Terraform, and CircleCI. 

My favorite tools include TypeScript/JS, C#, GoLang, and Python. For front-end I enjoy working with Angular and React. My best experiences in databases (sql and no-sql) include MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL & MySQL, as well as Redis, MongoDB and BigQuery.
